title: Unified Operations Notification + Communication Center
businessRequirement: Consolidate operational risk alerts, CR-003 Action Queue events, CR-004 SLA Level-1/2/3 escalations, assignment/reassignment events, failed integration alerts, document/payment/release-block notifications and acknowledgement/read/resolve state into one governed internal Operations Notification + Communication Center with direct links to the existing remediation surfaces.
objective: Provide one operational inbox for action, escalation and communication without creating a second workflow engine, duplicating source-of-truth records, or changing booking/finance/payment/document/release lifecycle rules.
preservedChangeRequests: CR-20260923-001 — Operations Control + Exception Dashboard — preserved by CR-006
CR-20260923-002 — ECOM resilience hardening — preserved by CR-006
CR-20260923-003 — Operations Action Queue + SLA Escalation — preserved by CR-006
CR-20260923-004 — Operations SLA Automation + Escalation Notifications — preserved by CR-006
CR-20260923-006 — Latest State Reconciliation + Final Staging Freeze — STAGING_ACCEPTED_LOCKED
impactedModules: existing Task / AuditEvent / failed IntegrationEvent data
existing user/role governance event data for notification preferences

scope.web: REQUIRED — evolve the existing Operational Risk Center into a unified internal notification/communication workspace while preserving WorkspaceShell, compact table/card conventions and existing navigation.
scope.api: REQUIRED — provide a scoped aggregated notification feed and governed acknowledge/read/resolve/preference endpoints over existing Notification, Task, Audit and automation event data.
scope.shared: REQUIRED — feed semantics, source links, acknowledgement state, role visibility and preferences must remain consistent between API and UI.
scope.databaseMigration: NOT_PLANNED — preference state should use existing governance/IntegrationEvent-backed data unless implementation proves an existing durable field is already available.
scope.lifecycleImpact: NONE — no automatic booking/document/payment/release state changes.

sources: CR-004 SLA LEVEL_1 / LEVEL_2 / LEVEL_3 automation notifications
communicationCenter: Single prioritized feed with source, severity, booking/job, owner, branch, timestamp and direct action link
UNREAD / READ / ACKNOWLEDGED / RESOLVED presentation without mutating the underlying transactional source
Bulk mark-read and scoped acknowledgement actions
Resolution reflected automatically when the underlying source clears where existing source supports auto-resolution
Direct links to Job, Documents, Payment, Tracking, Integration or Action Queue remediation surface
Conversation-style history derived from AuditEvent and automation/assignment events; no free-form external messaging in this CR
preferences: Per-user severity/category/channel preferences for internal in-app notifications
Role-default notification preferences for GLOBAL_ADMIN, CONTROL_TOWER, BRANCH_OPS and FINANCE
Preferences may suppress presentation/delivery of optional internal notifications but must never suppress mandatory CRITICAL/LEVEL_3 control-tower safety alerts
Preferences must not broaden booking/branch/customer data visibility
privacy: GLOBAL_ADMIN and CONTROL_TOWER may view global internal alerts consistent with existing scopes
FINANCE receives only finance/release-relevant operational notifications unless existing role scope grants more
CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE and AGENT remain denied from internal operational communication-center data unless a separate external-notification CR is approved

regressionPlan.rule: Planning only. After CR-004 staging acceptance and explicit CR-005 build approval, classify as SHARED and require full Web/API regression plus Action Queue, SLA Automation, unified notification-center, preference-scope and direct-remediation-link E2E before staging approval.

acceptanceCriteria: CR-001 Operations Control and CR-003 Action Queue behavior remain unchanged.
CR-004 SLA Level-1/2/3 escalation semantics and idempotency remain unchanged.

One internal feed consolidates operational risk, action-queue, SLA automation, failed integration, document/payment/release, milestone and reconciliation notifications without duplicate logical items.
Read, acknowledge and resolved presentation state is scoped to the authorized user/role and does not alter underlying transactional lifecycle state.
Direct job/remediation links resolve to the existing approved action surfaces.
User/role preferences cannot broaden data access and cannot suppress mandatory critical/LEVEL_3 alerts.
GLOBAL_ADMIN, CONTROL_TOWER, BRANCH_OPS and FINANCE permissions follow current internal scope rules.
CUSTOMER, SHIPPER, CONSIGNEE and AGENT cannot access internal notification-center content.
No database migration unless a later approved implementation review documents why existing governance/event storage is insufficient.
Full SHARED regression and targeted unified notification-center E2E must pass before staging deployment can be approved.
approvalRequired: Any further Web/API/shared runtime change requires a NEW explicitly approved change request. CR-005 is closed and locked. Production promotion remains prohibited.
